# autoremediator

> Fixes vulnerable npm dependencies from a CVE/GHSA id or scanner output: version bump, package-manager override, or an optional model-generated patch. Verifies every change, rolls back failures, and reports what it could not fix. Runs as a CLI, SDK, GitHub Action, GitHub App, MCP server or HTTP server. Requires Node.js 26+.

## Behavior

For each installed package in a vulnerable range, strategies are tried in order:
1. version bump to the lowest safe version (a major only if the policy sets `allowMajorBumps`)
2. package-manager override, when the package is transitive
3. generated patch, only when no safe version exists and a `model` (or SDK `patchGenerator`) is configured

Changes are installed, optionally tested/type-checked, and rolled back on failure. Unfixed results carry an `unresolvedReason`. Advisories: OSV, GitHub Advisory Database, NVD. Exploit signals: CISA KEV, FIRST EPSS. Offline mode reads advisories from a local snapshot file.

## Entry points

- CLI: `autoremediator <CVE|GHSA|scan-file> [--dry-run] [--run-tests] [--ci]`, plus `init` (sets up the project and coding-agent configuration), `guard <packages>` (judge packages before install: exit 0 clear, 3 check first, 4 blocked), `guard-hook` (Claude Code PreToolUse hook), `plan`, `runs`, `scan`, `update-outdated`, `portfolio`, `diff`, `triage`, `patches`, `reachability`, `evaluate`. With `--ci`, exit codes: 0 fixed or nothing to do, 1 failed, 2 partly fixed, 3 waiting for approval, 4 blocked by policy
- SDK: `init`, `remediate`, `planRemediation`, `applyPlan`, `verifyRun`, `rollbackRun`, `getRun`, `listRuns`, attempt functions, `remediateFromScan`, `remediatePortfolio`, `updateOutdated`, `scanDelta`, `checkReachability`, `evaluatePackage`, `guardPackage`, patch-artifact functions, job functions (`submit*Job`, `pollJob`), `toCiSummary`, `toSarifOutput`, `toCycloneDxVex`, `createLlmPatchGenerator`
- MCP (stdio, `autoremediator-mcp`): `health`, `remediate`, `planRemediation`, `remediateFromScan`, `remediatePortfolio`, `updateOutdated`, `applyPlan`, `verifyRun`, `resumeRun`, `rollbackRun`, `getRun`, `listRuns`, `startAttempt`, `proposePatch`, `verifyAttempt`, `finalizeAttempt`, `abandonAttempt`, `listPatchArtifacts`, `inspectPatchArtifact`, `validatePatchArtifact`, `reconcilePatchArtifacts`, `checkReachability`, `evaluatePackage`, `guardPackage`, `scanDelta`, `toVex`, `submitRemediateJob`, `submitScanJob`, `submitPortfolioJob`, `pollJob`
- HTTP: `POST /remediate`, `/plan-remediation`, `/remediate-from-scan`, `/remediate-portfolio`, `/update-outdated`, `/patches/{list,inspect,validate}`, `/vex`, `/jobs/{remediate,scan,portfolio}`, `GET /jobs/:id`, `GET /health`, `GET /openapi.json`. Authentication is required (`AUTOREMEDIATOR_API_TOKENS` or `AUTOREMEDIATOR_JWT_SECRET`).

## Key options

`cwd`, `dryRun`, `preview`, `runTests`, `typecheck`, `packageManager`, `policy`, `patchesDir`, `evidence`, `model` (`provider:model-id`, e.g. `anthropic:claude-sonnet-5-5`, needs `@ai-sdk/<provider>`), `patchConfidenceThresholds`, `offlineIntelligence`, `intelligenceSnapshotPath`, `exploitSignalOverride`, `slaCheck`, `skipUnreachable`, `dispositionPolicy`, `containmentMode`, `escalationGraph`, `campaignMode`, `simulationMode`, `proofOfFix`, `requireProofOfFix`, `breakingChangeRefactor` (experimental), `changeRequest`, `constraints` (`directDependenciesOnly`, `preferVersionBump`, `installMode`, `workspace`, `supplyChainPolicy`).

Precedence: explicit options, then the policy file (`.github/autoremediator.yml`), then defaults. Invalid policy files and snapshots are errors.

## Autonomy controls

- `dispositionPolicy` classifies each result as `auto-apply`, `hold-for-approval`, `simulate-only` or `escalate`.
- `containmentMode` rolls back applied `hold-for-approval` results; urgent `escalate` fixes (KEV, SLA breach) are kept.
- `escalationGraph` maps unresolved reasons to an intended action recorded in the report (nothing is sent automatically).
- `campaignMode` orders portfolio targets by `riskHint` and reports `threatRank`.
- `simulationMode` adds planned-mutation metadata to dry runs.
